is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes across Africa (page 1, Abstract; page 2, column 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Analyzes Vgsc mutations L1014F (L995F) and L1014S (L995S) (page 4, column 1; page 6, column 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary extractable genotype counts (RR/RS/SS), allele counts, or site-level frequencies with mosquito sample sizes are tabulated in the main text; data are presented only as aggregated geostatistical model outputs and scatter plots (Figs. 1F, 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were field-collected across 38 African countries in sub-Saharan Africa (page 2, column 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a secondary geostatistical modeling study re-analysing previously published and collated bioassay and kdr frequency data from Coleman et al. (2017) (page 5, Materials and Methods; page 6, column 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data were mapped to 1,183 specific sampling coordinates/locations across Africa (page 2, column 1; Fig. 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Underlying bioassay and genetic records have discrete collection years between 2000 and 2015 (page 2, column 1; page 6, column 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Directly uses collated data from Coleman et al. 2017 (Malar J 16:86): 'We obtained data on the prevalence of Vgsc mutations in mosquito samples from the dataset collated by Coleman et al. (26)' (page 6, column 1).

supplement.evidence: The study is fundamentally a secondary geostatistical re-analysis and modeling study of existing data rather than an eligible primary empirical report.

assessment.summary: This is a Bayesian geostatistical modeling study analyzing cross-resistance patterns and the relationship between phenotypic bioassay mortality (pyrethroids, DDT, carbamates, organophosphates) and Vgsc L1014F/S allele frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across Africa. Because it is a secondary modeling study re-analysing previously collated datasets from Coleman et al. (2017), it fails the primary empirical study and extractable raw data requirements.
exclusion_reasons: Pure modeling and secondary re-analysis study of previously published/collated datasets (not a primary empirical study)
No extractable population-level genotype or allele counts/sample sizes presented in the paper
